Proposition
[Solid-torus volume estimate] \group bounded volumeSource: thurston:page-0130, thurston:page-0131 For a hyperbolic solid torus of core length $l$ and radius $r_0$, \[ \vol =\pi l\sinh ^2r_0,\qquad \Area (\partial )=2\pi l\sinh r_0\cosh r_0, \] so $\Area (\partial )/\vol <1/2$, with limiting ratio $1/2$. Consequently \[ \vol (M)\le \vol (M_{[\eps ,\infty )})+\tfrac 12\Area (\partial M_{[\eps ,\infty )}). \]
Proof

\sketch Integrate the cylindrical hyperbolic volume density $\sinh r\cosh r$ and the boundary density $l\sinh r_0\cosh r_0$; the ratio follows directly.

□
